In flat 3hrs  we had a full plan ready and the invite was sent to all his friends and family and yohoo we were so busy with the preparations. Kforkids team really involved us at every step and that made it really enjoyable for us in curating the videos, the theme etc. The quality of creatives/theme/invite was excellent!! Every commitment on timeline was professionally met,  on time in effect! Thanks for everything   highly recommended to celebrate with Kforkids
